name: Architecture Project Administration
audience: small architecture firms and design-project administrators
topic: consultant deliverables and construction-administration decisions for architects

products.name: Consultant Deliverable Board
products.product: A focused architecture consultant deliverable tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small architecture firms and design-project administrators
products.problem: Structural, MEP, civil, landscape, and specialist deliverables arrive through separate transmittals, making current version, review status, and drawing dependencies difficult to see.
products.valueProposition: Turns architecture consultant deliverable tracking into a visible operating queue so every consultant deliverable is received to the agreed milestone, reviewed against dependencies, and incorporated into the controlled project set.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets architect consultant deliverables, design consultant tracker, architecture coordination log, and consultant submittal schedule searches.

products.name: RFI Decision Register
products.product: A focused architectural RFI decision tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small architecture firms and design-project administrators
products.problem: RFI questions, responses, sketches, cost impacts, and drawing updates are linked imperfectly, so a answered item can still leave unresolved design work.
products.valueProposition: Turns architectural RFI decision tracking into a visible operating queue so every RFI response identifies the authoritative decision, impact, and required document updates before operational closure.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets RFI tracking for architects, RFI decision log, construction administration RFI, and architect RFI workflow searches.
